title: A never-firing cron crashes Kanidm and localVersions 1 silently loses every backup

source.reference: v0.24.1 live backup review (campaign plan #1207). F4A.3: schedule '0 0 31 2 *' passed the webhook and the Schedule showed Ready=True, but Kanidm 1.11.2 rewrote it to '0 0 0 31 2 * *', found no upcoming date and refused to start; the primary crashlooped for about 5 minutes. F4A.1/F4B.3: localVersions 1 was admitted by CRD CEL (>= 1) and the webhook, the schedule controller errored before writing any status, and the operator still rendered KANIOP_BACKUP_VERSIONS=1, so Kanidm rotated each file before the sidecar's 120 s minimum age and 0 of 4 backups were uploaded.

required_properties: One pure cron validator in kaniop-backup-core reproduces Kanidm's rewrite exactly (exactly 5 ASCII-whitespace fields become '0 <expr> *', every other count passes through) and requires upcoming(Utc).next() to exist
The webhook, the schedule controller and the operator's resolve_backup_config all use that validator; no component keeps its own divergent cron check
resolve_backup_config renders no backup configuration for an invalid Schedule that already exists, using a pure check rather than gating on Schedule status
The schedule controller reports Ready=False with InvalidSchedule for a bad cron and InvalidSpec for localVersions below 2 instead of returning an error before writing status
The CRD CEL rule and the webhook reject localVersions below 2; CRDs and examples are regenerated, not hand-edited
A table-driven unit test covers 5, 6 and 7 fields, '0 0 31 2 *', '@daily', 5 fields plus a year, and common valid crons
The regression tests fail on the starting commit for the expected reason
User documentation states the localVersions minimum and the cron rules
forbidden_changes: Hand-editing charts/kaniop/crds/crds.yaml or files under examples/
A validator that prepends '0 ' for any field count, or that only parses without checking for a future occurrence
Gating Kanidm rendering on the Schedule Ready condition instead of a pure validity check
Putting the shared validator in libs/backup, which the operator crate cannot depend on
Editing restore Job code under libs/operator/src/kanidm/restore/
